key_headlines.title: Super Budget of 820.9 Trillion Won Amid National Debt Ratio Illusion
key_headlines.summary: President Lee's administration presented a record-breaking 2027 budget focused on growth, projecting national debt ratio to decrease to 48.3% and fiscal deficit to improve to -0.1% of GDP. However, concerns persist that national debt may actually increase by 22.7% by 2030 due to reliance on temporary semiconductor boom tax revenues.

key_headlines.title: Future Home Prices Hinge on Tax Reform and Interest Rates
key_headlines.summary: A survey of real estate experts found that 55.6% cite tax system changes and 50% cite interest rate hikes as the most critical factors affecting future home prices. Only 16.7% of surveyed professionals expect Seoul apartment prices to stabilize next year, with half expecting continued instability.

key_headlines.title: Bank Profitability Declining Despite Consecutive Rate Hikes
key_headlines.summary: Despite the Bank of Korea raising rates in July and August, the banking sector's net interest margin (NIM) declined quarter-over-quarter in the third quarter. This occurred as both lending rates and funding costs rose simultaneously, offsetting expected margin expansion.

key_headlines.title: Global EV Battery Market Growing 19.7% While Korean Makers Lose Share
key_headlines.summary: The global electric vehicle battery market grew 19.7% year-over-year through September 2026, but Korean battery makers' market share fell 4.1 percentage points to 12.6%. Chinese top seven manufacturers now dominate with 73% market share.

key_headlines.title: OpenAI Secures Only Half of 30 Billion Dollar Fundraising Goal
key_headlines.summary: OpenAI has secured approximately 11 billion dollars out of its 30 billion dollar fundraising target, with major investors showing lukewarm response due to concerns about high capital costs and uncertain profitability in the AI industry.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea announced a record 820.9 trillion won budget for 2027 emphasizing economic growth, with projections showing improved fiscal metrics on a temporary basis. The government claims the national debt ratio will decrease to 48.3% and fiscal deficit will narrow to -0.1% of GDP, but analysts warn these improvements depend heavily on sustained semiconductor sector revenues that may not materialize beyond 2029. The budget represents the largest fiscal stimulus yet, raising concerns about fiscal sustainability and future debt burden if economic growth slows.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government's flagship Future Response Fund faces sustainability concerns as analysis shows additional tax revenue will cease from 2029 onwards, potentially creating fiscal pressures during economic downturns. While the administration projects improved fiscal indicators, the baseline forecasts rely on temporary revenues from the semiconductor sector boom rather than structural improvements. The Bank of Korea's rate decisions and government fiscal expansion remain key factors in shaping the economic outlook, with the central bank's final rate decision of the year scheduled for late November to address persistent growth and inflation concerns.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market showed mixed performance with the KOSPI initially declining to the 5700 level before rebounding, supported by optimism about U.S. midterm elections and corporate earnings strength. Treasury bond yields fell significantly in October due to risk-averse sentiment from stock market weakness, with some market participants viewing the decline as an over-correction given the ongoing rate hike cycle. Foreign exchange markets saw the won-dollar rate strengthen to the 1300 level, reducing currency losses for financial institutions and lowering risk-weighted assets across major banks.
sections.Industry & Technology: The global electric vehicle battery market expanded 19.7% through September 2026, but Korean battery manufacturers lost significant market share, declining 4.1 percentage points to 12.6% as Chinese competitors captured 73% of the market. Hyundai Motor launched new certified used vehicle services providing transparent data on driving history, battery condition, and vehicle maintenance records to address information asymmetry in the secondary EV market. Meanwhile, South Korea's EV and battery industries face intensifying competition from Chinese manufacturers offering lower prices, with concerns growing about supply chain dependencies on foreign AI models and technologies.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate experts expressed pessimism about Seoul apartment price stabilization, with only 16.7% expecting stability in 2027 and 50% anticipating continued weakness in the near term. Tax system changes and interest rate policies emerged as the most critical factors influencing future home prices, cited by 55.6% and 50% of surveyed professionals respectively, alongside concerns about loan regulations and housing supply dynamics. Seoul apartment prices have posted the strongest year-to-date gain in recorded history through October 2026, with limited near-term supply and ongoing inventory pressures likely to sustain price pressures despite government stabilization measures.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. midterm elections scheduled for November 3rd carry significant implications for Trump administration policies including tariffs on pharmaceutical imports and other sectors, with potential impacts on Korean companies' export strategies. The Federal Reserve held rates steady at 3.75-4.00% in late October while signaling potential further rate increases if inflation remains elevated, creating uncertainty for global financial markets. Some Fed officials have publicly called for at least two additional rate hikes, suggesting continued pressure on global borrowing costs despite concerns about economic growth, with South Korea's central bank facing similar policy dilemmas.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence is reshaping digital advertising markets, with Meta gaining efficiency from AI-driven advertising while Google faces threats to its search advertising business from AI chatbot competitors. Chinese AI companies are raising token costs after initially using low pricing to penetrate markets, signaling potential future cost pressures for Korean AI adopters and highlighting the need for domestic AI model development. The energy storage systems market is expanding rapidly due to AI data center power demands and renewable energy growth, shifting competitive advantages toward companies with superior operational capabilities and supply chain management rather than pure price competition.
sections.Others: The FBI officially identified North Korea as the perpetrator of a recent 8 trillion won cryptocurrency theft from Binance, prompting concerns about digital asset security. Shinhan Investment Securities launched an AI-powered conditional search service allowing retail investors to specify investment criteria in natural language, representing broader integration of AI tools into retail financial services. The U.S. midterm election outcome will influence ongoing policy uncertainties including tariff regimes and potential implications for Korean pharmaceutical and technology exports to the American market.
